chapterInfo.content:
42
Onyankopɔn ma Hiob so bio
1Ɛnna Hiob gyee AWURADE so sɛ:
2Mahunu sɛ wotumi ade nyinaa yɛ,
na wɔrensi wo tirimbɔ biara kwan.
3 # Hiob 38.2; Mmb 28.13; 1 Yoh 1.9 Hwan ne deɛ ɔnni nimdeɛ,
na ɔhono afotuo ani yi?
Enti na mekaa deɛ mente aseɛ, anwanwadeɛ a ɛsene me a na mennim.
4 # Hiob 38.3 Tie ɛ, na menkasa.
Mɛbisa wo, na woakyerɛ me.
5Sɛ aso teɛ nko na metee wo nka,
na afei deɛ, m’ani nso ahu wo.
6Saa nti na mepo me ho na menu me ho,
dɔteɛ ne nso mu.
7Na AWURADE kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Hiob wieeɛ no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Temanni Elifas sɛ: Me bo afu wo ne wo mfɛfoɔ baanu no, ɛfiri sɛ moanka me ho asɛm a ɛtene sɛ m’akoa Hiob. 8#Hes 14.14 Na afei momfa anantwinini nson ne adwennini nson, na monkɔ m’akoa Hiob nkyɛn, na monkɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mma mo ho, na m’akoa Hiob mmɔ mo tiri so mpaeɛ, na ɔno nko ara anim na mɛhwɛ, na me ne mo anni no mo nkwaseasɛm so, ɛfiri sɛ moanka me ho asɛm tee sɛ m’akoa Hiob. 9Ɛnna Temanni Elifas ne Suhini Bildad ne Naamani Sofar sii mu kɔ kɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ wɔn no; na AWURADE tiee Hiob mpaebɔ.
10 # Hiob 8.7 Na Hiob bɔɔ ne nnamfo no tiri so mpaeɛ no, AWURADE danee ne duamda no na AWURADE de adeɛ a Hiob nyaeɛ no nyinaa mmɔho mmienu maa no. 11Ɛnna ne nuanom mmarima nyinaa ne ne nuanom mmaa nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔni no kane nyinaa baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔne no bɛdidii wɔ ne fie, na wɔgyam no, na wɔkyekyeree ne werɛ, amaneɛ a AWURADE maa no baa ne soɔ nyinaa ho, na wɔn mu biara maa no sika dwetɛbena baako ne sika kaa baako. 12Na AWURADE hyiraa Hiob awieeɛ senee ne mfitiaseɛ, na ɔnyaa nnwan mpemdunan ne yoma mpemnsia ne anantwie mpamho apem ne mfunumu abereɛ apem. 13Na ɔnyaa mmammarima baason ne mmammaa baasa. 14Ne mmammaa no, ɔtoo ɔbaako din Yemima, na deɛ ɔdi soɔ no de Kesia, na deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no de Keren-hapuk. 15#Num 27.8-11 Na wɔanhunu mmaa a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ sɛ Hiob mmammaa no asase no nyinaa so; na wɔn agya memaa wɔn agyapadeɛ wɔn nuanom mu. 16Na yei akyiri no, Hiob dii mfirinhyia ɔha aduanan, na ɔhunuu ne mma ne ne mma mma awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nnan. 17#Gye 25.8 Na Hiob wui, na wabɔ akora pa ara.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ɛnna Hiob gyee AWURADE so sɛ:
Mahunu sɛ wotumi ade nyinaa yɛ,
na wɔrensi wo tirimbɔ biara kwan.
Hwan ne deɛ ɔnni nimdeɛ,
na ɔhono afotuo ani yi?
Enti na mekaa deɛ mente aseɛ, anwanwadeɛ a ɛsene me a na mennim.
Tie ɛ, na menkasa.
Mɛbisa wo, na woakyerɛ me.
Sɛ aso teɛ nko na metee wo nka,
na afei deɛ, m’ani nso ahu wo.
Saa nti na mepo me ho na menu me ho,
dɔteɛ ne nso mu.

Na AWURADE kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Hiob wieeɛ no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Temanni Elifas sɛ: Me bo afu wo ne wo mfɛfoɔ baanu no, ɛfiri sɛ moanka me ho asɛm a ɛtene sɛ m’akoa Hiob. Na afei momfa anantwinini nson ne adwennini nson, na monkɔ m’akoa Hiob nkyɛn, na monkɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mma mo ho, na m’akoa Hiob mmɔ mo tiri so mpaeɛ, na ɔno nko ara anim na mɛhwɛ, na me ne mo anni no mo nkwaseasɛm so, ɛfiri sɛ moanka me ho asɛm tee sɛ m’akoa Hiob. Ɛnna Temanni Elifas ne Suhini Bildad ne Naamani Sofar sii mu kɔ kɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ wɔn no; na AWURADE tiee Hiob mpaebɔ.
Na Hiob bɔɔ ne nnamfo no tiri so mpaeɛ no, AWURADE danee ne duamda no na AWURADE de adeɛ a Hiob nyaeɛ no nyinaa mmɔho mmienu maa no. Ɛnna ne nuanom mmarima nyinaa ne ne nuanom mmaa nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔni no kane nyinaa baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔne no bɛdidii wɔ ne fie, na wɔgyam no, na wɔkyekyeree ne werɛ, amaneɛ a AWURADE maa no baa ne soɔ nyinaa ho, na wɔn mu biara maa no sika dwetɛbena baako ne sika kaa baako. Na AWURADE hyiraa Hiob awieeɛ senee ne mfitiaseɛ, na ɔnyaa nnwan mpemdunan ne yoma mpemnsia ne anantwie mpamho apem ne mfunumu abereɛ apem. Na ɔnyaa mmammarima baason ne mmammaa baasa. Ne mmammaa no, ɔtoo ɔbaako din Yemima, na deɛ ɔdi soɔ no de Kesia, na deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no de Keren-hapuk. Na wɔanhunu mmaa a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ sɛ Hiob mmammaa no asase no nyinaa so; na wɔn agya memaa wɔn agyapadeɛ wɔn nuanom mu. Na yei akyiri no, Hiob dii mfirinhyia ɔha aduanan, na ɔhunuu ne mma ne ne mma mma awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nnan. Na Hiob wui, na wabɔ akora pa ara.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
